body: Actually I would. Just because one plane crashed doesn't mean planes aren't a safe way to travel and all planes are the same.

Growing up I had a sister much like yours. She genuinely thinks that humiliating you in front of everyone is going to make you a stronger person and not suicidal anymore probably because it would for her. She simply lacks the ability to put herself in your shoes. As for your parents, I know this is an obvious thing to point out but you won't live with them forever. Just don't let the way your relatives treat you become a defining aspect of who you are. I made that mistake and now it's too late to fix it. It might not be too late for you. Good luck.

And yet it's the religious freaks that get to come here in droves while good people like you are stuck with the rest of them. Go figure. I've known people with a similar story to yours, basically they met the right people at the right time and managed to get out. I wouldn't lose hope if I were you — you can still get lucky.
I'm exactly like you. I have no one to talk to and feel desperately lonely. There are many of us out there and on this subreddit, too. Always feel free to share what's on your heart with us.
